title: Engineering MXenes for electrochemical environmental pollutant sensing
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2024, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EN00255E, Critical Review
Muhammad Hussnain Afzal, Wajeeha Pervaiz, Muhammad Asif, Zhuo Huang, Jiawei Dai, You Xu, Jiannan Zhu, Tiansui Zhang, Zhuang Rao, Guangfang Li, Zhengyun Wang, Hongfang Liu
This review comprehensively summarizes and discusses the recent advances in MXene-based electrochemical environmental pollutant sensing by integrating the sensing behavior of MXenes, modular fabrication methods and selectivity improvement strategies.
